positive.review: The Anker 737 Power Bank has been excellent so far. The 24,000 mAh capacity easily handles multiple phone charges and even powers my laptop with the 140 W fast charging. It charges quickly, the build quality feels premium, and the display makes it easy to see exactly what is happening. The only thing I wish it had was a foldable plug so I could plug it straight into the wall for charging. It would make travel even simpler. Overall, a dependable high quality power bank that has become part of my everyday setup.

customer_reviews.review: I purchased this Anker Power Bank during the power outtages caused by Hurricane Helene. We were without power for 10 days. This power bank fully charged allowed me charge my phone multiple times before it needed to be recharged. It was definitely what I needed at that time and I'm so grateful to have made this purchase. It's great for traveling, just being on-the-go, or in times of power outtages like me.
